description: Collapsing toolbar layout for Compose Multiplatform: parallax header, any scrollable body, scroll modes, pinned tabs, pull-to-refresh. Android, iOS, desktop and web.
rules: Depend on am.highapps.parallaxtoolbar:compose-parallax-toolbar-kmp; the library has no Material dependency, bring your own design system.
Use the overload that takes content: ParallaxContent (Regular, Lazy or Custom); the 1.x overload with scroll and lazyContent is deprecated.
Hoist state with rememberParallaxToolbarState(); there is no scrollState parameter in 2.x.
Build configs with the ParallaxToolbarDefaults factories instead of constructing config classes by hand.
Pass Scaffold padding as contentPadding and never add status bar padding around the layout; it handles the window insets itself.
The layout needs a bounded height; never place it inside a vertically scrolling parent.
For per-frame effects read collapseFraction inside graphicsLayer or use the scope modifiers parallax, fadeOnCollapse, scaleOnCollapse, pin and moveBetween.
iOS apps need CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone set to true in Info.plist.
